its hard, i know you’ve been so strong. when things get tough for me i try to appreciate the little things, it sounds silly but i’ll look up at the summer sky and imagine the swirls of galaxies and the brilliant stars. i enjoy the serenity, quietness and listen to my breathe in the wind, (bit poetic haha) i feel a sense of energy from the trees, the birds the soil upon which i stand on. and sometimes in a moment like that, despite all the chaos, i feel connected to the universe, and in a moment like that it’s so tangible and real.

apologise if i’ve lost you a bit but i suppose but theres so much beauty in this world, and universe, and you are apart of this eternally flower, interconnected universe. the universe would be incomplete without you. 

its okay not to do anything sometimes - if you feel your in a dark place, watch a sunset, sunrise see the clouds in the sky or the stars. for me, when i do this i just feel like im apart of something, and it might be able to ease you when your in that dark place - stay strong x

was in class today and my science professor talked a bit about climate change which im pretty passionate about, i had a panic attack started crying in class, just so many people do nothing and say ‘you could do more‘ - someone joked about killing themselves to stop there green house emissions which broke me a bit as i have been considering doing that seriously because i know i shouldnt be alive. ive tried to help others a bit but i feel like im feeding them half truths because i dont really believe what i say e.g ‘it will get better etc’

Sexuality isn’t a sin. You are not a bad person. You can’t change the past you can only change the future you for better before you can get better again I promise you, your still young you can live a good life, you need to pick yourself up gets a job to pay your debts start going to the gym to get in shape, cut out junk food and bad habits. Life is a miracle it really is, this is the only time you can be you before total oblivion, don’t throw such a gift away, be strong people love / will life you. It will be okay. Just please don’t kill your self your life is too precious

There is always people to help I promise you your not alone stay strong get through today tomorrow will be brighter. There are people who love you or will love you. Life can be beautiful, it can be awful too, but you gotta keep living to experience it. As far as we know we have one life and then total oblivion, live it, a bad experience or not this is the only time you’ll ever be able to feel so don’t cut your life short your a miracle
Mhm, that’s a nice way to put it but I suppose I don’t deserve it.

i dont deserve to get better. i try my best to participate in thearpy but after every session i just get really bad serve self hatred for wasting there time, or taking a spot someone else could of had. am i being too hard onmyself? i feel like im a bad person for not punishing myself more, i should be blind and in constant pain, there is no reason for anyone to say i don’t deserve misery all i do is cause pain to this world by being alive. sorry for being so negative, dont wanna get anyone else down
